name: Taverley Dungeon
accessNote: Black demon area has safespots by the south-west stalagmites and in a north-east crevice; requires Dusty Key or 70 Agility. Also contains lower-level Black dragon spawns and task-only baby black dragon access. Blue dragon area contains 9 adult Blue dragons and 12 baby Blue dragons, supports a cannon, and is the fast baby-blue-dragon task option; ring of dueling plus Enlightened Journey can speed banking. Hellhounds here have 13 spawns, support a cannon, can be safespotted on rocks and columns, and 80 Agility is highly recommended.

travel.note: Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
